description: Loan details page showing user's loan information (principal, term, monthly payment) and a button to calculate total loan payments. Calls /total_loan_payments via AJAX when button is clicked.
notes: Page contains JavaScript that makes AJAX calls to /total_loan_payments. The backend endpoint is vulnerable to SSTI. Potential for: DOM-based XSS if JSON parsing is unsafe, indirect exploitation through /total_loan_payments SSTI.
